text:
alex: Heads-up team 5050 - we're targeting Wed 22:00 UTC for the rollout. Need a final internal note + one-line customer bullets. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/release/2026-03-22-draft (please edit).

sam: Added pin matrix and confirmed model pin: model-x@v2.3.1. No auto-rotate. Added fallback to cpu-quant v2.2.

maria: I'll draft the rollback table and the canary pass/fail criteria. dropping a short table in the doc now.

liz: copy note - microcopy must be 1 line per bullet. I'll do a pass on customer-facing phrasing after you add content.

ops-oncall: Ops note - freeze request for UI and customer-facing docs: 21:30023:30 UTC. APAC overlap flagged; add embargo/locales text and the handoff to APAC oncall at 23:15 UTC.

sam: Adding timezone handoff snippet + contact list. Also adding the ops pin CLI commands for the blast.

deploybot: [deploy-bot] Scheduled: canary 22:00 UTC -> ramp. Playbook: /runbooks/releases/2026-03-22. Canary window 20m. Auto-rollback triggers: 5xx > 1% sustained for 10m OR p95 latency increase > 2s over baseline for 10m. Alerts posted to #incidents and #eng-oncall.

alex: Good. Maria, include the exact numbers above in the internal note so comms can reference them if we need to notify customers.

maria: done 5050 pasted thresholds + sample alert messages (copyable). Also added a quick rollback step list for oncall.

liz: Draft internal blurb: "Wed 22:00 UTC deploy: small API param rename, perf/cost improvements, model pin v2.3.1. Ops standby 22:0000:00 UTC. Freeze 21:303:30 UTC. See internal doc for rollback lanes." Too long?

alex: good. shorten second sentence: "Ops standby 22:003:00 UTC." Keep tiny.

support: Heads-up - we need a short FAQ line for support: how billing might appear after the change. Alex/Liz please ping before the blast so we can stage answers.

liz: will send a 3-line FAQ to support by 18:00 UTC. Legal OK with wording; no sign-off required.

ops-oncall: One more ops checklist: confirm reserved capacity for dedicated pools during the first hour. If capacity < 90% after ramp, we hold and investigate. Adding to doc.

sam: acked and added the reserved capacity note + commands to check pool status.

alex: timeline: edits done by 17:30 UTC, final pin and announcement at 18:30 UTC in #eng-releases. Can everyone ack?

maria: ack.

sam: ack.

liz: ack.

support: ack - will standby the FAQ snippet.

ops-oncall: ack - will prepare handoff notes and escalate path.

alex: thanks all. I'll pin the final internal blurb at 18:30 UTC and post the deploybot cue immediately after. :white_check_mark:
